model.title: Load Forecasting Enhancement Act
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Troy Balderson (R-OH)

summary.text: The bill would require the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to establish regional boards with state utility commissions to study best practices for predicting electricity demand and improve how utilities forecast power needs. It would also encourage states to adopt these recommendations and tie federal energy conservation funding to states implementing better electric load forecasting practices.
